record.title: Gashuunsukhait–Ganqimaodu coal interruption with disputed 30–31 August 2021 return
record.exceptions: Coal freight only. Testing delays continued after the reported return; those delays do not establish a further closure. The two attributed accounts disagree between 30 and 31 August.
record.enforcement: Two attributed reports agree that coal transport returned but differ by one calendar date; neither gives an exact start.
record.consequences: No general economic effect is quantified by this research packet.
record.relationship: Distinct from R3-EA-005 February–March 2020 coal interruption. No current/pending August 2021 coal parent found; June 2021 test interruptions remain separate unexpanded leads.
record.status_observation: Historical dated evidence only; an unknown endpoint is not evidence of present open or closed status.
record.current_timing: Contested: dated evidence; numeric duration withheld; see qualification
record.current_corrections: The finance minister account dates coal return to 30 August 2021; the Bloomberg market-provider account dates it to 31 August. The bound preserves that disagreement. Onset is unknown; a reported fourteen-day halt is not subtracted from either return. Continued testing delays do not establish a further full closure.
